name: 30-student mixed class
description: A larger classroom sample used to evaluate whether class-level summaries scale beyond the initial 3-20 student range.

class_features.understanding_profile: large mixed class with clear low, middle, and high achievement groups
class_features.question_tendency_profile: quiet students, confirmation seekers, and active questioners coexist
class_features.motivation_profile: broad motivation distribution with disengaged and highly motivated students
class_features.misconception_profile: multiple misconception clusters across transposition, coefficient division, negatives, and fractions
class_features.teacher_note: Use this class to test whether class-level summaries remain readable at 30 students.
